description: Blades clips at a timeline frame. Splits every listed clip (and its linked partner) into two independent clips at atFrame. Frames are in the target timeline's fps. Use with get_timeline to find clip ids first.

atFrame.description: Timeline frame to cut at (must lie inside each clip).

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: split_clips
title: Split clips
